domain.title: Domain
domain.description: Host name of the RunR console, e.g. runr.example.com. Create a DNS record for it pointing to the cluster ingress. Function URLs use a separate wildcard domain configured later in RunR (Regions).

edition.title: Installation type
edition.description: single-tenant: one organization uses this RunR (users sign in with local accounts). multi-tenant: several tenants share this RunR — each tenant has its own data schema and CPU / memory quota per region, and SSO providers (OpenID Connect / OAuth) can be added.

username.title: Username
username.description: First administrator, created at install time.

password.title: Password
password.description: At least 12 characters. Leave empty to generate one — it is stored in the Secret runr-secret (key ADMIN_PASSWORD) in the installation namespace. Applied only on first install.

enabled.title: Expose through ingress
enabled.description: Publishes the console on the domain above through the cluster ingress controller.

className.title: Ingress class
className.description: Ingress class of the controller that publishes the console, e.g. traefik.

mode.title: TLS certificate
mode.description: letsencrypt: cert-manager issues the certificate (annotation cert-manager.io/cluster-issuer; without cert-manager in the cluster it behaves like none). custom: the chart stores certificate + privateKey in a kubernetes.io/tls Secret. secret: your own kubernetes.io/tls Secret named by secretName. none: no tls section, the ingress controller serves its default certificate. Empty: enabled / clusterIssuer / secretName decide (values written before 0.3.6).

enabled.title: Enable TLS
enabled.description: Only used when mode is empty.

clusterIssuer.title: cert-manager ClusterIssuer
clusterIssuer.description: mode letsencrypt: defaults to letsencrypt-prod. mode empty: if set, cert-manager issues the certificate.

secretName.title: TLS Secret name
secretName.description: Defaults to runr-tls (letsencrypt) or runr-tls-custom (custom); required with mode secret.

certificate.title: Certificate (PEM)
certificate.description: mode custom: full chain, server certificate first. Base64-encoded PEM is accepted too.

privateKey.title: Private key (PEM)
privateKey.description: mode custom: unencrypted private key of the certificate. Never printed by the chart.

images.title: Uploaded images
images.description: Container images and WebAssembly modules uploaded into region registries (docs/images.md).

uploadImage.title: Receiver image
uploadImage.description: Image of the upload receiver Job in the regions. Empty: ghcr.io/brf-tech/runr/image-upload:1.1.0.

quotaGb.title: Storage per organization (GiB)
quotaGb.description: Uploaded images over every region. Empty: 50; 0: unlimited.

runtimePatches.title: Runtime patches
runtimePatches.description: The signed feed that announces runtime image patches: level, reason, CVEs and deadlines (docs/runtimes.md#runtime-patches, docs/security.md#runtime-patch-feed).

feed.title: Feed
feed.description: OCI reference of the patch feed. Empty: ghcr.io/brf-tech/runr/runtime-patches:feed.

publicKey.title: Feed public key
publicKey.description: cosign public key (PEM) the feed's signature must verify with. Default: the key BRF-Tech/runr-runtimes signs the feed with. Empty: the feed is off and platform administrators see a warning.

viaRegion.title: Read through a region
viaRegion.description: Region id or name whose internal registry (its ghcr.io pull-through) the feed is read through, for an API without a way out. Empty: read directly.

autoMigrate.title: Migrate at deadlines
autoMigrate.description: At a critical or zero-day patch's deadline, redeploy the projects still behind onto it (rolled back when the new revision does not become ready). The default; platform administrators switch it on the Patches page.

globalDns.title: Global projects and global DNS
globalDns.description: The zone of the global projects and the PowerDNS server every taking-part platform region runs for it (docs/global-projects.md). Each region is enabled in the UI (Region → General → Global DNS); these are the platform defaults.

storageClass.title: Storage class of the server's volume

serviceAnnotations.title: Annotations of the DNS LoadBalancer Service

geoipUrl.title: GeoIP database of proximity mode
geoipUrl.description: Gzipped MaxMind-format city database, {yyyy}/{mm} the current month. Empty: DB-IP IP to City Lite (CC BY 4.0); "-": none.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: acme: cert-manager DNS-01 for *.<zone> in every region (default); none: the region's default certificate.

failover.title: Failover of a global project's primary

afterSeconds.title: Seconds of failed health checks before an automatic failover

dataLink.title: Data link of the bindings of global projects

port.title: Port of the home region's Traefik
port.description: TLS with SNI on websecure. Empty: 443.

apiProduct.title: API product
apiProduct.description: API keys, JWT routes, plans and usage of the gateways (docs/api-product.md).

gatewayAuthImage.title: gateway-auth image
gatewayAuthImage.description: Image of the gateway-auth service in the regions. Empty: ghcr.io/brf-tech/runr/gateway-auth:1.0.0.

callbackUrl.title: Callback URL
callbackUrl.description: RunR's base URL as the regions reach it. Empty: the region agent's URL.

orgTransfer.title: Organization export / import
orgTransfer.description: Packages of an organization exported and imported again (docs/org-export.md).

transferImage.title: Transfer agent image
transferImage.description: Image of the transfer pods in the regions (binding data, images). Empty: ghcr.io/brf-tech/runr/image-upload:1.1.0.

podDiskGb.title: Transfer pod disk (GiB)
podDiskGb.description: One binding's dump or one image. Empty: 20.

supplyChain.title: Software supply chain
supplyChain.description: SBOMs, vulnerability scans, image signatures and the admission policy per region (docs/supply-chain.md). Each region is configured in the UI (Region → Supply chain); these are the platform defaults.

enabled.title: Supply-chain runs after builds
enabled.description: Every image RunR builds gets an SBOM, a scan and a signature as its region's settings define.

toolsImage.title: Tools image
toolsImage.description: Image of the supply-chain Jobs (syft, trivy, cosign, oras). Empty: ghcr.io/brf-tech/runr/supply-chain:1.0.0.

jobNamespace.title: Job namespace
jobNamespace.description: Namespace of the supply-chain Jobs and the signing key in each region. Empty: runr-supply-chain.

trivyDbSource.title: Vulnerability DB source
trivyDbSource.description: Copied into the region registry in mirror mode. Empty: mirror.gcr.io/aquasec/trivy-db:2.

allowedOrigins.title: Further allowed origins
allowedOrigins.description: Origins besides the console's own (https://<domain>) whose browser pages may call the API, e.g. https://portal.example.com. A list, or one comma-separated string.

affinity.title: Gateway affinity
affinity.description: Affinity of the gateway pods; empty: placement.affinity.

affinity.title: API affinity
affinity.description: Affinity of the API pods; empty: placement.affinity.

images.description: Not read by the chart: the uploaded-image settings are the top-level images.* values.

supplyChain.description: Not read by the chart: the supply-chain settings are the top-level supplyChain.* values.

size.title: Application storage
size.description: Git repositories of projects and logs, e.g. 10Gi. Can be grown later, never shrunk.

accessModes.title: Access modes
accessModes.description: Access modes of the API volume, set when the claim is created. ReadWriteOnce: the API, Horizon, scheduler and Reverb pods run on the volume's node. ReadWriteMany (with a ReadWriteMany StorageClass): they run on any node.

storageClassName.title: StorageClass
storageClassName.description: Empty: the cluster's default StorageClass. Set when the claim is created.

affinity.title: UI affinity
affinity.description: Affinity of the UI pods; empty: placement.affinity.

driver.title: Database driver
driver.description: pgsql, the only driver the chart supports: the API, Horizon, scheduler and Reverb pods share one PostgreSQL server (the chart's or yours).

password.title: Database password
password.description: Password of database.user, written to the chart's Secret (secret.create=true). Empty: generated on the first install and kept.

existingSecret.title: Database password Secret
existingSecret.description: A Secret of yours that holds the password (key existingSecretPasswordKey).

storageClassName.title: Database StorageClass
storageClassName.description: StorageClass of the built-in PostgreSQL volume; empty: the cluster's default. Set when the claim is created.

username.title: Redis user
username.description: ACL user name; empty: the default user.

password.title: Redis password
password.description: Written to the chart's Secret (secret.create=true); the chart's Redis then requires it.

existingSecret.title: Redis password Secret
existingSecret.description: A Secret of yours that holds the password (key existingSecretPasswordKey).

existingSecret.title: SMTP password Secret
existingSecret.description: A Secret of yours that holds the password (key existingSecretPasswordKey).

encryption.title: SMTP encryption
encryption.description: Empty or starttls: STARTTLS when the server offers it (TLS from the first byte on port 465). tls: TLS from the first byte on any port.

enabled.title: NetworkPolicies
enabled.description: Allow exactly the connections docs/install.md lists, deny the rest (needs a CNI that enforces NetworkPolicy).

gatewayFrom.description: NetworkPolicy peers that may reach runr-gateway; empty: any source.

to.description: Peers of the outbound connections; empty: any destination.

ports.description: TCP ports of the outbound connections; empty: every port.

extraEgress.description: Further egress rules of the API, Horizon, scheduler, Reverb and hook pods.

clientIp.title: Client IP
clientIp.description: How the API finds the client IP (per-IP rate limits, audit IPs) behind ingress controller → runr-gateway.

trustedProxies.title: Trusted proxy addresses
trustedProxies.description: CIDRs the proxies connect from, comma-separated; private_ranges = RFC 1918 / IPv6 ULA / loopback / link-local (the pod network). Empty: no proxy is trusted.

proxyHops.title: Proxy hops
proxyHops.description: Proxies in front of the API that append to X-Forwarded-For. 0 = automatic: 2 with the Ingress, 1 without.

ai.title: AI (GPU support, Hugging Face models)
ai.description: Images and charts for GPU support and Hugging Face model services (docs/ai.md, docs/huggingface.md). Point the images at a registry the regions reach for air-gapped installations.

browse.title: Browse the Hub from the console
browse.description: Off for consoles without internet access: models are uploaded or imported.

billing.title: Billing
billing.description: Billing module (docs/billing.md): RunR calculates a monthly bill per project (payer: the project owner) and, with tenancy, per tenant for shared platform regions; an external invoicing system reads bills and usage through the billing API and receives signed events on the webhook. Leave the webhook URL empty to keep events for GET /api/billing/events only.

enabled.title: Billing module
enabled.description: BILLING_ENABLED: turns the Billing module of the API on. Off: metering keeps running, no money is calculated.

currency.title: Billing currency
currency.description: BILLING_CURRENCY: ISO 4217 code of every price and bill of the installation, e.g. USD or EUR.

webhookUrl.title: Billing webhook URL
webhookUrl.description: Billing events (bill.closed, bill.paid, bill.payment_url_set, fixed_request.approved, region_share.accepted, project.stopped, …) are POSTed here. Empty: no delivery. A webhook saved in Settings → Billing wins.

webhookSecret.title: Billing webhook signing secret
webhookSecret.description: HMAC-SHA256 key of the X-RunR-Signature header: sha256=HMAC(secret, "<X-RunR-Timestamp>.<raw body>"). Stored in the Secret runr-secret (key BILLING_WEBHOOK_SECRET). Empty: events are sent unsigned.

branding.title: Branding
branding.description: Brand of this installation (docs/white-label.md) — applied at start-up, no rebuild. Per field, a value saved in Settings → Branding wins over these values; resetting it there brings these back. Empty fields: the RunR default (RunR by BRF Teknoloji).

productName.title: Product name
productName.description: Shown in the console header, login page, browser title and e-mails. Empty: RunR.

companyName.title: Company name
companyName.description: Copyright line of the login page and e-mails. Empty: BRF Teknoloji.

light.title: Logo (light background)
light.description: Light theme and e-mails. https URL, a data:image/…;base64,… URI (SVG, PNG, JPEG, WebP, ICO; at most ~700 KB) or a reference to a key of an existing ConfigMap / Secret in the release namespace whose content is one of those (or raw <svg> markup). Empty: the RunR default.

dark.title: Logo (dark background)
dark.description: Dark themes and the login page. https URL, a data:image/…;base64,… URI (SVG, PNG, JPEG, WebP, ICO; at most ~700 KB) or a reference to a key of an existing ConfigMap / Secret in the release namespace whose content is one of those (or raw <svg> markup). Empty: the RunR default.

mark.title: Logo mark (square icon)
mark.description: Compact places such as the collapsed header. https URL, a data:image/…;base64,… URI (SVG, PNG, JPEG, WebP, ICO; at most ~700 KB) or a reference to a key of an existing ConfigMap / Secret in the release namespace whose content is one of those (or raw <svg> markup). Empty: the RunR default.

favicon.title: Favicon
favicon.description: Browser tab icon. https URL, a data:image/…;base64,… URI (SVG, PNG, JPEG, WebP, ICO; at most ~700 KB) or a reference to a key of an existing ConfigMap / Secret in the release namespace whose content is one of those (or raw <svg> markup). Empty: the RunR default.

primary.title: Primary colour
primary.description: Either one base colour "#rrggbb" (shade 500; 300–900 are derived from it) or the full scale {"300": …, …, "900": …} with "#rrggbb" or "r g b" values.

accent.title: Accent colour
accent.description: "#rrggbb" — highlights such as the wordmark letter. Empty: RunR red.

poweredBy.title: Show "Powered by RunR"
poweredBy.description: Shown on a re-branded login page and in e-mails. Default true.

logo.title: E-mail logo
logo.description: Empty: the light logo. A data: URI is served to mail clients through /api/branding/assets/email_logo. https URL, a data:image/…;base64,… URI (SVG, PNG, JPEG, WebP, ICO; at most ~700 KB) or a reference to a key of an existing ConfigMap / Secret in the release namespace whose content is one of those (or raw <svg> markup). Empty: the RunR default.

tenantOverrides.title: Tenant branding
tenantOverrides.description: Multi-tenant: tenant owners may brand what their users see.

storage.title: Storage
storage.description: Overrides api.storage.size and database.postgres.storage when set. Volumes can be grown later, never shrunk.

application.title: Application storage
application.description: Git repositories of projects and logs, e.g. 20Gi.

projectSecrets.title: Project secrets
projectSecrets.description: Where RunR writes the values of the projects' secret variables (docs/security.md).

storage.title: Secret value storage
storage.description: region: straight into the Kubernetes Secret of the project's region, RunR's database keeps metadata only. database: encrypted in RunR's database (the behaviour up to 0.5.10, deprecated).

finalize.title: Finalize the upgrade from 0.5.10
finalize.description: Once the upgrade from 0.5.10 is confirmed: the bootstrap Job runs secrets:move-to-region --finalize, which drops the encrypted copies of secret values RunR keeps for a rollback and allows secret store references. RunR 0.5.10 cannot be installed again afterwards without losing secret values (docs/upgrade.md).

quota.title: Resource ceiling
quota.description: CPU and memory the functions of this installation may use in total. Applied as a ResourceQuota (with a LimitRange of default container requests / limits) in the project namespace of each Region; in the multi-tenant edition also the default tenant quota and the upper bound of all tenant quotas on a Region. 0 or empty: no ceiling.

cpu.title: CPU ceiling (vCPU)
cpu.description: Total vCPU, e.g. 8 or 0.5. 0 or empty: no CPU ceiling.

memoryGiB.title: Memory ceiling (GiB)
memoryGiB.description: Total memory in GiB, e.g. 16. 0 or empty: no memory ceiling.

knative.title: Regions
knative.description: What RunR installs in its Regions (docs/regions.md).

minK8sMinor.title: Minimum Kubernetes minor version of a Region

traefikImage.title: Region Traefik image
traefikImage.description: Empty: RunR's mirror of the pinned Traefik version.

install.title: Install cert-manager in Regions without one
install.description: A cert-manager the cluster already runs is reused either way, and never removed by RunR.

acmeEmail.title: ACME e-mail (Let's Encrypt)
acmeEmail.description: Account e-mail of the Let's Encrypt issuer RunR creates in Regions reachable from the internet; setting it accepts the ACME server's terms. Empty: those Regions use their own CA too. A Region can set its own (cert_manager_acme_email).

chartVersion.title: cert-manager chart version
chartVersion.description: Empty: the version this release pins.

imagePrefix.title: cert-manager image prefix
imagePrefix.description: Registry path of the cert-manager-<component> images. Empty: RunR's mirror (ghcr.io/brf-tech/runr/reqs).

observability.title: Observability
observability.description: Tracing backend per Region (OpenTelemetry Collector + Grafana Tempo), request replay, uptime checks, status page and alert delivery (docs/observability.md).

defaultMode.title: Default tracing mode of a Region
defaultMode.description: managed: RunR installs the collector and Tempo with Knative Serving. reuse / external / off are chosen per Region in the console.

installWithServing.title: Install the tracing backend with Knative Serving

knativeSampleRate.title: Knative span sampling
knativeSampleRate.description: Share of requests whose activator / queue-proxy spans are recorded (0 to 1).

collectorChartVersion.title: OpenTelemetry Collector chart version
collectorChartVersion.description: Empty: the version this release pins.

tempoChartVersion.title: Tempo chart version
tempoChartVersion.description: Empty: the version this release pins.

collectorImage.title: OpenTelemetry Collector image
collectorImage.description: Empty: ghcr.io/brf-tech/runr/reqs/opentelemetry-collector-contrib at the version of the pinned chart.

tempoImage.title: Tempo image
tempoImage.description: Empty: ghcr.io/brf-tech/runr/reqs/tempo at the version of the pinned chart.

ingestUrl.title: RunR URL seen from Region pods
ingestUrl.description: Empty: the URL the Region's agent connects to.

loadTest.title: Load tests
loadTest.description: k6 load tests of HTTP projects, run in the project's Region against the project's own URL (docs/load-test.md). The test traffic is metered like any other traffic.

maxConcurrentPerRegion.title: Load tests at once per Region

image.title: k6 image
image.description: Empty: ghcr.io/brf-tech/runr/reqs/k6 at the version the API pins.

sandboxApi.title: Sandbox API
sandboxApi.description: Isolated execution of untrusted code for AI agents and apps: plain pods in a namespace per organization under each region's strongest sandbox class (Kata Containers, gVisor; runc only where a region allows it). Regions, warm pools and organization quotas are configured in Settings → Sandboxes; these are the platform defaults and ceilings.

enabled.title: Enable the Sandbox API
enabled.description: Off: the /api/sandboxes endpoints and their scheduled jobs are not registered.

namespacePrefix.title: Namespace prefix
namespacePrefix.description: Sandboxes of an organization run in the namespace <prefix>-<organization> of each region.

allowCustomImages.title: Allow custom images
allowCustomImages.description: Sandboxes may run any image instead of a runtime of the catalog.

bindings.title: Bindings
bindings.description: Managed KV, object storage and Postgres that projects attach to (docs/bindings.md). The data services are installed per region from the console (Region → Data services).

namespace.title: Data namespace
namespace.description: Namespace of the region data services (KV Redis, object store, Postgres clusters).

retentionDays.title: Retention after delete (days)
retentionDays.description: A deleted binding keeps its data this many days; it can be restored until then.

storageClass.title: Storage class
storageClass.description: Storage class of the data service volumes. Empty: the cluster default.

quotas.title: Limits per organization
quotas.description: Per organization (per tenant in the multi-tenant edition). 0: unlimited.

maxBindings.title: Bindings
maxBindings.description: Number of bindings of every type.

kvMb.title: KV memory (MB)
kvMb.description: Sum of the memory limits of KV bindings.

objectGb.title: Object storage (GB)
objectGb.description: Sum of the bucket quotas of object bindings.

postgresGb.title: Postgres storage (GB)
postgresGb.description: Sum of the storage of Postgres bindings.

dedicatedPostgres.title: Dedicated Postgres clusters
dedicatedPostgres.description: Number of Postgres bindings with their own cluster.

gitDeploy.title: Git deploy
gitDeploy.description: Project git remotes (https://<domain>/git/<organization>/<project>.git), push-to-deploy from GitHub, GitLab and Forgejo/Gitea, and preview environments of pull requests (docs/git-deploy.md).

enabled.title: Git deploy
enabled.description: Off: the /git endpoints and provider webhooks answer 404.

maxPushMb.title: Largest push (MB)
maxPushMb.description: Largest pack one git push may send.

remoteOwner.title: Remote URL owner
remoteOwner.description: Path segment before the project in remote URLs of the single-organization edition (multi-tenant: the organization's slug).

webhookBaseUrl.title: Webhook base URL
webhookBaseUrl.description: Base URL git providers call the webhooks at. Empty: https://<domain>.

limit.title: Previews per project
limit.description: Default limit of live previews per project; projects can change it up to maxLimit.

ttlHours.title: Preview lifetime (hours)
ttlHours.description: A preview without a new commit for this long is deleted.

bootstrap.title: Bootstrap Job
bootstrap.description: The post-install / post-upgrade hook Job runr-bootstrap and the Job runr-region-reconcile-<revision> (docs/helm-values.md).

regionReconcileSeconds.title: region:reconcile deadline (seconds)
regionReconcileSeconds.description: The Job runr-region-reconcile-<revision> brings the regions to the release after helm upgrade returned (not a hook). Seconds each of its three attempts may start region:reconcile steps for; the step running then runs to its end (up to 30 minutes more), and the Job's activeDeadlineSeconds follows. 3600 covers one region cluster's worst case on an upgrade from 0.5.10; steps the deadline leaves are done by the next attempt; raise it for many region clusters.

placement.title: Placement
placement.description: Where RunR's own pods run: every Deployment and hook Job of the chart.

tolerateDedicatedWorkers.title: Tolerate dedicated workers
tolerateDedicatedWorkers.description: RunR's pods tolerate the taint runr.dev/dedicated=projects:NoSchedule that a region's worker selection puts on this cluster's nodes, and prefer the other nodes: a pod whose volume is bound to a node selected later still starts there. Added to the tolerations and affinity below.

tolerations.title: Tolerations
tolerations.description: Added to every RunR pod as given.

affinity.title: Affinity
affinity.description: Affinity of every RunR pod unless gateway.affinity, api.affinity or ui.affinity replaces it for that component; podColocation and tolerateDedicatedWorkers add their terms to it.
